**Chinese name:** 中颖电子股份有限公司 (Zhōngyǐng Diànzǐ)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bellwether of China's most commoditized MCU market: FY2025 revenue ¥12.84亿 (-4.4%) in a price war, H1 2026 ¥7.22亿 (+10.8%, net +72.9%) recovering — with the control transfer and capital injection a deliberate consolidation play toward automotive/robotics as appliance MCU demand saturates.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Appliance/industrial MCUs, BMICs for tools/batteries, AMOLED DDICs, early automotive MCUs.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | State-Backed Design House |
| **Founded** | 1994 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Home-appliance/industrial MCUs (~60% of revenue, domestic leader), battery-management ICs (~30%), AMOLED display drivers |
| **Node Sophistication** | Mature MCU nodes; no advanced-node exposure |
| **Entity List** | No |
